name: moh731V2023Moh729bHbvBase
description: MOH 729B F-MAPS, Hepatitis B patients who are HIV-ve: the clients MOH 731 2.4 HBV Screening at ANC counts as HBV positive (HV02-20, moh731V2023AncHbvBase -- ANC tests and known-positive visits, once per client per day, with an HBV result 1375 = 703 at the locations in the period) whose ANC HIV result is Negative. Hep B regimen: the ARVs recorded for them (1088) in the month up to that visit -- LAMIVUDINE AND TENOFOVIR (1400) -> HPB1A TDF + 3TC, EMTRICITABINE AND TENOFOVIR (6180) -> HPB1B TDF + FTC -- otherwise HPB1C, with the regimen 'Not recorded' (no Hep B treatment is recorded in AMRS today). One row per visit, oldest first: the service keeps each client's latest.

expressionOptions.expression: CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amrs.obs o JOIN amrs.encounter e ON e.encounter_id = o.encounter_id AND e.voided = 0 WHERE o.person_id = a.patient_id AND o.concept_id = 1088 AND o.value_coded = 1400 AND o.voided = 0 AND e.encounter_datetime < DATE_ADD(a.anc_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE_FORMAT(a.anc_date, '%Y-%m-01')) THEN 'TDF + 3TC' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amrs.obs o JOIN amrs.encounter e ON e.encounter_id = o.encounter_id AND e.voided = 0 WHERE o.person_id = a.patient_id AND o.concept_id = 1088 AND o.value_coded = 6180 AND o.voided = 0 AND e.encounter_datetime < DATE_ADD(a.anc_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE_FORMAT(a.anc_date, '%Y-%m-01')) THEN 'TDF + FTC' ELSE 'Not recorded' END

CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amrs.obs o JOIN amrs.encounter e ON e.encounter_id = o.encounter_id AND e.voided = 0 WHERE o.person_id = a.patient_id AND o.concept_id = 1088 AND o.value_coded = 1400 AND o.voided = 0 AND e.encounter_datetime < DATE_ADD(a.anc_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE_FORMAT(a.anc_date, '%Y-%m-01')) THEN 'HPB1A' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amrs.obs o JOIN amrs.encounter e ON e.encounter_id = o.encounter_id AND e.voided = 0 WHERE o.person_id = a.patient_id AND o.concept_id = 1088 AND o.value_coded = 6180 AND o.voided = 0 AND e.encounter_datetime < DATE_ADD(a.anc_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE_FORMAT(a.anc_date, '%Y-%m-01')) THEN 'HPB1B' ELSE 'HPB1C' END
